sections.title: Analysis of Algorithms
sections.description: An investigation of paradigms for design and analysis of algorithms. The course will include dynamic programming, flows and combinatorial optimization algorithms, linear programming, randomization and a brief introduction to intractability and approximation algorithms. The course will include other advanced topics, time permitting. Prerequisite: Data Structures and Algorithms at the undergraduate level.
